pillar_artifacts.body: Synthetic receipts separate subject digest agreement, media type, predicate version, disclosure minimization, linkability risk, status, recovery, and verifier policy. No real key, signature, credential, issuer, holder, verifier, account, or trust decision is present.

pillar_artifacts.title: CBR museum remedy, return, and authority reservations
pillar_artifacts.body: The matrix reserves access, treatment, movement, return, repatriation, remedy, privacy, legal, cultural, data-governance, tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori-authority decisions to competent external people and authorities. Repository software makes zero real decision.
